item.summary: fix(ci): stop killing healthy discord Vitest runs and repair partial runtime-env mocks (#123131) The discord extension shard's silent transform/import startup (~210s measured on a loaded macOS host) exceeded the run-vitest wrapper's 120s default no-output timeout, so the watchdog killed healthy runs (#123025). The config now gets the extra-long budget like the other large shards. Three discord tests mocked openclaw/plugin-sdk/runtime-env with bare factories missing most exports; under isolate=false they poison the shared worker module cache and break later files that bind logVerbose/sleepWithAbort through the shared process test harness. They now spread importOriginal and override only their stubs. Fixes #123025
